SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-02-2010 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BURTON, SALVADORE (GUARDIAN) BURTON, SALVANISHA  (MINOR) IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SAN FRANCISCO UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT THE COURT RECOGNIZES THAT THE CALIFORNIA CONSTITUTION GRANTS THE RIGHT TO SAFE SCHOOLS; HOWEVER INDIVIDUALS DO NOT HAVE A PRIVATE RIGHT OF ACTION TO SEEK DAMAGES UNDER THAT CONSTITUTIONAL PROVISION. IN THIS CASE THE EVIDENCE SUBMITTED WAS NOT SUFFICIENT TO ESTABLISH NEGLIGENCE BY THE SCHOOL STAFF. AS A RESULT, THE COURT IS NOT ABLE TO AWARD DAMAGES.
